description:
Add a home screen widget to the existing WeatherApp project. The project is already open in Android Studio. You need to create the following files:

1. Widget Layout (`app/src/main/res/layout/widget_weather.xml`): Include 3 TextViews with IDs `widget_city_name`, `widget_temperature`, and `widget_condition`.

2. Widget Metadata (`app/src/main/res/xml/weather_widget_info.xml`): Use `<appwidget-provider>` with minWidth=180dp, minHeight=60dp, updatePeriodMillis=1800000, and reference the layout.

3. Provider Class (`app/src/main/java/com/example/weatherapp/WeatherWidgetProvider.kt`): Extend `AppWidgetProvider`, override `onUpdate`, and use `RemoteViews` to update the text.

4. Register in AndroidManifest.xml: Add the `<receiver>` with the `android.appwidget.action.APPWIDGET_UPDATE` intent filter and the metadata.

Finally, build the project to verify it compiles.
